viewing_check: Wind and set the alarm to see if the movement runs, the day-date changes and the alarm rings; check case back for 4006-xxxx reference and serial; look at how bad the dial flaking is up close; check for polish and crystal condition; note the strap is a replacement and there is no bracelet.
